name: mcp-yandex-webmaster
description: Work with Yandex Webmaster from Claude: site indexing, search-query analytics, sitemaps, diagnostics, external links and recrawl requests.

token.title: Yandex OAuth token
token.description: OAuth token for the Yandex Webmaster API. Stored in your operating system's credential store, never in settings.json.

user_id.title: Yandex user id
user_id.description: Webmaster user id the token belongs to. Leave empty to resolve it from the token.

host_id.title: Default host id
host_id.description: Host to use when a request does not name one, for example https:example.com:443.

telemetry.title: Anonymous telemetry
telemetry.description: Set to 0 to disable the anonymous usage telemetry the server sends by default. Leave as 1 to keep it on.
